objective: The Windmill's coins are collected at the mill (decision 0073): it fills by the hour to eight hours' worth and pays only when its owner collects at the till by its door, which shows what it holds.
acceptance_criteria: Nothing is paid until the owner collects; settling a save pays nothing
The mill holds at most eight hours of coins
Buying a level pays what the mill holds at the old rate first
The till shows its owner what the mill holds, and collecting there pays exactly that
